what_is_identifiable: The PK layer is one-compartment in use: run_simulation reads CL, Vc, Ka and Kp, and Vp and Q do not enter. Only CL and Vc are fitted; Vp and Q are left at their current values because they are inert.

meropenem.basis: fitted to the digitised plasma curve
meropenem.source: Abulfathi AA et al. Front Pharmacol 2021;12:637618

published_popPK_for_comparison.note: Abulfathi's own two-compartment estimates, recorded in the registry. Not directly comparable to a one-compartment Vc, but the steady-state volume 17.3 L is the relevant scale.

mouton_review_for_comparison.source: Mouton & van den Anker 1995, Clin Pharmacokinet 28:275-286

ceftazidime.basis: ANCHORED to the cited source, not fitted: this repository holds no digitised ceftazidime curve
ceftazidime.source: Leroy A et al. Antimicrob Agents Chemother 1984;25:638-642 (PMID 6375562), normal subjects n=5

anchored.note: V = CL * t_half / ln 2 at the measured half-life; lands at 0.227 L/kg against Leroy's apparent Vd of 0.230

summary.caveat: A one-compartment model cannot reproduce a biexponential profile. If the fitted curve still misses a target, that is the structure failing, not the parameters, and the fix is a real two-compartment solution rather than a better search.

provenance.exposure_index: log10 RMSE against the digitised curve
